description:
*Club Assembly of Rotary Club of Borivli
The Chief Guest for the evening was *Assistant Governor, District 3141 – Rtn. Rajendra Kewat.*
Thereafter, *President Rtn. Aarti Parekh* delivered her welcome address, detailing the various projects undertaken by RCB till date in RY 2026-27 and sharing the ambitious future plans of the Club.
This was followed by comprehensive presentations by the Avenue Directors. Reports on 11 Avenues were presented to the AG.
AG Rtn. Rajendra Kewat, in his address, congratulated *Rtn. Dr. Bharat Pandya* for being nominated as RIPN for RY 2028-29. He appreciated all Directors for their well-structured and systematic reports.
He lauded RCB for its exemplary efforts, both in conceiving impactful projects and in their seamless execution. Speaking on Membership, he emphasized the importance of member retention alongside induction. He expressed great happiness at RCB's application for establishing 3new Interact School Clubs
